filmability.viewer_question: What should happen before a remote materials experiment reaches physical equipment?
filmability.opening_action: An explicitly illustrated virtual sample chamber changes under a simulated temperature condition while the separate physical gas cylinder valve stays closed. These are generic explanatory equipment, not an actual READINESS installation.
filmability.mechanism: Proposed experiment → digital-twin simulation → approved physical experiment. An uncertainty branch goes to researcher review instead of visibly operating the equipment.
filmability.human_consequence: Researchers at emerging institutions, startups and smaller firms may gain remote access to equipment and expert oversight they lack; access and safety outcomes are not yet proven.
filmability.source_limit: Funding and intended architecture are verified; actual READINESS hardware, exact deposition process, valve interlock, test metric, live user route and achieved results were not established. Do not portray a literal installed safety valve, autonomous approval, fabricated readings or completed thin-film manufacture.
filmability.ordering: Recognizable physical inputs → distinguish virtual rehearsal from physical equipment → uncertainty goes to human review → physical experiment remains pending. Keep the sample and equipment identity through all cuts.
filmability.strongest_picture: A virtual chamber undergoing a trial beside the same illustrated physical chamber remaining unchanged; the closed physical valve makes the separation visible without a numeric output.
filmability.strongest_picture_development: The changing virtual condition creates the question of permission; the next image shows the uncertain experiment reaching researcher review while the physical state remains pending.
filmability.hardest_missing_picture: No authenticated operating READINESS footage or actual human review performance was found. Show review as a labeled proposal or held experiment; never invent a scientist gesture, real interface or observed safety stop.
filmability.unpictured_spoken_concept: Expanded access for a small company cannot be proven by an anonymous person or an opening door; attribute it as the project aim in narration and avoid an invented successful user campaign.
filmability.likely_false_inference: Viewers may infer an installed working autonomous lab or a real valve safety interlock. Immediate Illustration / Planned system disclosure and unchanged physical equipment must prevent that inference.
filmability.rejected_visual_approach: Observed documentary is unavailable: the Rice page supplies stock AI art, an abstract project graphic and a Jun Lou portrait, none showing the synthesis task. A cinematic scene is a second treatment proposal only if it preserves generic equipment disclosure and no synthetic human performance.
three_key_images: Generic physical sample chamber and closed gas supply, with a separate virtual trial
Virtual experiment conditions change; physical apparatus stays unchanged
Uncertain proposal is held for researcher review; no manufactured result appears

asset_leads.rights_basis: No explicit reuse licence found on fetched article. Research reference only; not admitted for production reuse.
asset_leads.decision: Reject as principal picture; use original source-backed illustration

visual_stakes.affected_person: Materials researchers at emerging research institutions, startups and small or midsize firms; named research lead Jun Lou
visual_stakes.physical_subject: Illustrative materials sample, synthesis chamber and gas supply
visual_stakes.visible_change: Virtual trial changes while corresponding physical apparatus does not; uncertainty shifts proposed experiment to review
visual_stakes.consequence: Researchers retain judgment before uncertain planned work proceeds; broader access remains an aim
visual_stakes.opening_question: What happens before the proposed experiment reaches the physical apparatus?
visual_stakes.answer: READINESS plans digital-twin rehearsal, safety limits and researcher consultation on uncertainty before approved physical experiments
visual_stakes.asset_fit: Original explanatory illustration; inspected source graphic is reference-only and not useful action footage

action_proposals.visible_action: A solid translucent model of the conserved generic chamber receives a broad finite input front. Full-surface heat, large qualitative pressure controls and a second model mixture change distinctly before a supported virtual sample trial. Hypothetical feedback arrives and holds before the next proposed setting; an enlarged uncertainty question reaches pending researcher review.
action_proposals.consequence: Researchers could inspect modeled inputs and a proposed trial before physical use. Future result feedback could inform recommendations and uncertainty could return to researcher judgment; no physical operation or scientific success is depicted.
action_proposals.limits: Original generic apparatus and qualitative planned-research illustration, not an actual Rice machine, interface, numerical model output, synthesis process, grown film, measured material property, actual approval or mandatory hardware interlock. The researcher review destination is an abstract editorial node.
action_proposals.source_basis: Rice states that a digital twin will simulate experiments before physical equipment, learn from results and consult researchers when uncertain.
